topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Well, look at me, taking on this role as if I've been the lord of the manor all my days. They say a student has been accused of taking another's work as their own. Tsk, tsk. It seems the young folk these days forget that the harvest of our minds, like the harvest of the soil, must be tended with honesty and care. When I sow my seeds, I do so with the sweat of my brow and the grace of the saints. I know every furrow as I know my own skin. A man's worth, or a woman's, isn't measured by what they can steal but by what they can grow from the good earth and their own hands. May the accusing tongues turn to prayer for the lad's guidance instead, for it’s clear he's forgotten the value of hard-earned knowledge.
